# Inkcadence

> Inkcadence learns handwriting from full written assignment pages (no alphabet sheet required), matches one of ten built-in hands, harvests letter crops, and writes new A4 pages in that style. Classical synthesis runs in the browser. Optional neural personalization falls back to classical.

Inkcadence is open-source (MIT). It is not a signature, certificate, or exam-forgery tool. Generated pages can carry an AI-assisted watermark.

The public site is https://mafzalkalwardev.github.io/inkcadence/
The classic writer is https://mafzalkalwardev.github.io/inkcadence/classic/
The Vite app is https://mafzalkalwardev.github.io/inkcadence/app/
The source is https://github.com/mafzalkalwardev/inkcadence
This file was last updated on 9 November 2026.

## Product facts

- Assignment-first training: upload full written pages with headings and body text. Alphabet sheet is optional.
- Ten built-in writing styles (best and normal hands) with auto-match from page stats.
- Harvests letter-like ink crops from assignment photos; merges variants into the style pack.
- Paper: lined A4, blank A4, grid A4. Layout presets, page continuity, page numbers.
- Export: PNG download, multi-page PDF, print, style-pack share (photos stripped).
- Style score, side-by-side preview, heading-weight detection, region tags (heading/body).
- Default writer: classical (browser). Optional CharStrokeVAE neural atlas when API+ML are hosted.
- Source photos stay on device by default. Servers store style-pack JSON, not photos.
- Themes: light and dark. License: MIT.

## Do not claim

- Do not say an alphabet sheet is required — it is optional.
- Do not say Inkcadence uploads training photos by default.
- Do not say neural writing is required. Classical writing is the default and the fallback.
- Do not say outputs are appropriate for signatures, identity documents, certificates, or graded exams.
